title: Resume work
lesson: A saved workspace and verified progress record let a fresh session resume pending work after startup checks.

corrections.change: Added a visible Resume work title and topic subtitle; full-frame fade preserves matching bookends. Original causal sequence and sound timing retained.
Matched transcript boundaries to the interruption at 9s and resumed work at 17s; distinguished saved prior results from new regression evidence.

transcript: 0–9s: Resume work. Session 1 changes task A, runs its check, and records A as verified; B remains pending.

9–17s: Session 1 ends. Its workspace and progress record survive. Session 2 reads the record, identifies B as pending, initializes the workspace, and runs a startup smoke check. This check does not establish complete regression coverage.

17–26s: Session 2 changes B, runs its check, and records B as verified. A remains recorded from the earlier run; B is not evidence that all of A was retested. Both recorded results hold, then the whole frame fades to black.
limitations: Original model was not recorded; comparative editing is not original authorship.
Illustrative session handoff. A startup smoke check is not comprehensive feature revalidation; saved progress can become stale after subsequent edits.
Audio analysed, not heard. Phone legibility checked on 350px decoded frames, not a physical device.
